maddeler.e:
نرتكب (form VIII)
# نَرْتَكِبُ (nartakibu) /nar.ta.ki.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
# نُرْتَكَبُ (nurtakabu) /nur.ta.ka.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
# نَرْتَكِبَ (nartakiba) /nar.ta.ki.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
# نُرْتَكَبَ (nurtakaba) /nur.ta.ka.ba/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
